explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/673: 'Can one prove an asymptotic formula for Σ_{n≤X} G(n)?' The statement answers with Σ G(n) ~ X log X. The page itself does not state this formula; it gives Tao's bounds τ(n/m)/m ≤ G(n) ≤ τ(n), so Σ G ≤ (1+o(1)) X log X. The asymptotic is plausible, since under τ-weighting the divisors are dense on the log scale and consecutive ratios tend to 1, and it is backed by a linked Lean proof. Faithful, with the solved status resting on that proof.
